metadata.summary: ChestX-ray8 comprises 108,948 frontal-view X-ray images of 32,717 unique patients with text-mined eight disease image labels (multi-label), later expanded to 14 labels; labels derived from radiological reports using natural language processing; collected at NIH Clinical Center.
metadata.purpose: Weakly-supervised multi-label image classification and disease localization for common thoracic diseases.

papers.title: ChestX-ray8 / NIH ChestX-ray14 — Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification applied; no further details provided.

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。
pending_verification: geography.countries 由局限文本启发式推断，待人工核实

known_limitations: Weakly-supervised labels derived from NLP on radiology reports introduce label noise and incompleteness.
Single-center origin (NIH Clinical Center) limits geographic, demographic, and practice-setting diversity.
No reported age, sex, or ethnicity distribution; subgroup representativeness unknown.
Frontal-view only; lacks lateral or other projections.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ from single U.S. academic medical center (NIHCC); no evidence of multi-institutional or international representation.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Generalizability limited by single-center origin, weak supervision, and lack of demographic metadata.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage data reported (e.g., age, sex, race, socioeconomic status).
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Demographic attributes (age, sex, ethnicity) not reported; clinical metadata beyond report-derived labels not provided.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing chest X-ray at NIH Clinical Center

annotation.annotation_method: Text-mined from radiological reports using natural language processing (NLP)
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels derived from radiological reports via NLP; weakly supervised, multi-label, no manual verification stated.
annotation.label_noise_description: Labels are text-mined and subject to NLP extraction errors; no ground-truth expert annotation provided.
